summary_en: Interim dividend per share increased to ¥18.00 from ¥15.00 for the fiscal year ending March 2027. Full-year dividend forecast raised to ¥36.00 per share, comprising ordinary dividends of ¥15.00 at interim and ¥15.00 at year-end, plus ¥3.00 commemorative dividend at each date, marking the company's 60th anniversary.
title_en: Notice regarding dividend of surplus (interim dividend) and revision of dividend forecast (commemorative dividend)
translation_en_brief:
Car Mate Mfg. announced on October 30, 2026, that it has raised its interim dividend to ¥18.00 per share from the previously forecast ¥15.00, and revised its full-year dividend forecast for the fiscal year ending March 2027 from ¥30.00 to ¥36.00 per share. The interim dividend increase reflects the company's 60th anniversary celebration in June 2026.

Under the revised dividend policy, the company will pay ordinary dividends of ¥15.00 at the interim stage and ¥15.00 at year-end, with an additional commemorative dividend of ¥3.00 at each date. This structure brings the total annual dividend to ¥36.00 per share. The interim dividend payment totals ¥126.971 million, with an effective date of December 2, 2026, based on a record date of September 30, 2026.

The company stated that the commemorative dividend is intended to express gratitude to shareholders and other stakeholders for their continued support throughout the company's 60-year history.
